perf-corridor
js:
(() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, a = C.worldFromLatLon(43.6408, -79.401), b = C.worldFromLatLon(43.644, -79.383);
app.teleportTo(a.x, a.z, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [a.x, 45, a.z], look: [b.x, 0, b.z], fov: 50 }); })();(async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const app=window.__CITY_APP;const run=async(label)=>{await sleep(1200);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<3000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});console.log('[perf] '+label+' '+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(1)+' ms');};await sleep(2500);await run('layer-on');app.streetcars.group.visible=false;app.railCorridor.group.visible=false;await run('layer-hidden');app.streetcars.group.visible=true;app.railCorridor.group.visible=true;})()
